payload.scope: Local integrity and same-source/toolchain repeatability only

privacy.scope: Tracked unstaged changes and all new audit/test additions; staged-only npm run privacy also passed on an empty index. Heuristic scan, not proof of absence.

limits: Local results are not a remote CI run or immutable qualification evidence.
Initial sandboxed CI could not inspect processes; successful checks use ordinary local process and loopback access.
Playwright version and metadata binding do not prove arbitrary installed package bytes, package-manager version or browser identity.
The runtime was cached via npm exec; project dependency files were not changed.
Draft requirement inventory is not owner approval or an authoritative ledger disposition.

sandboxAttempt.scope: Original sandbox run lacked process inspection. Its exact log-owning process group was verified and stopped; passing baseline and final checks use ordinary process access.
